title: Three interchangeable cuffs on integral studs
status: Local TPU/stud fit approved; full jaws and loaded phone retention unvalidated

bom.name: Rigid shaft clamp cap
bom.note: Approved (user assessment 2026-10-30). Taller cap walls meet the flat fixed jaw across a 1 mm split gap; inner extent X-4.8. Slot end ligaments thickened 1.6 to 2.6 mm; slot width 8.8 mm unchanged. 110 mm collar spans Z-40..70; two screws on each axial side of the jaw at Z-30/+60. Entire outer side at X12: body, crossing, rail wings and four screw seats share one bed plane. Use 1.8 mm shorter collar screws and the extended bracket bearing plate. New full collar fit and loaded retention unvalidated.

bom.name: Centered fixed stud, sliding track and shaft saddle
bom.note: Approved (user assessment 2026-10-30). Flat collar underside at X-5.8 with approved ramp below the fixed band hook; guide-floor slot with35-degree roof. Four screw mounts, track edges/stops and centered cuff unchanged. End strips trimmed to cap planes Z -38.5 / 68.5; no reprint requested for this visual refinement.

bom.name: Sliding dual-stud jaw
bom.note: Approved (user assessment 2026-10-30). Two fins end flush with the fixed rails at Y +/-13.8 mm, with 0.4 mm top clearance; wraparound skirts removed. Two 31 x 4 mm beam openings with 3.8 mm edge rails. Continuous121.6 mm beam flush with central root at X-10/-2. Studs100 mm apart; jaw sits5.2 mm farther out to keep cuff contacts unchanged. Tongue design retained; engagement and band preload need physical checks. See flush-beam slice.

bom.name: Interchangeable 21.6 mm TPU cuff
bom.note: Approved (user assessment 2026-10-30). One unchanged shape at all three contacts: 6.8 mm square passage, 9.6 x 6.8 mm head recess. Integral seating ribs. ELEGOO TPU95A; previous square-stud fit successful, new ramped-stud pull-out resistance and full phone grip unqualified.

bom.name: Braced triangular-guide actuator bracket
bom.note: Open rail wrap with direct single-bolt clamping and anti-rotation cheeks. 28.05 mm triangular tunnel, connected tail wall and rounded anchor corners. Exact current PETG plate geometry; zero sliced supports. End-on rail installation; physical grip and strength pending.
bom.approval: Design approved; current print pending physical assessment

bom.name: Triangular sliding plunger with curved foot
bom.note: Captured triangular shaft, retracted curved contact foot and rounded lower retaining lip. Insert before fitting 1 mm string and 1 mm-thick band. Exact current PETG plate geometry; zero sliced supports. Button reach, sliding fit and wrap retention pending.
bom.approval: Design approved; current print pending physical assessment

bom.name: Deep-groove redirect pulley
bom.note: Unchanged approved deep-groove redirect pulley; reused. Repositioned to the raised bearing in this assembly.

bom.name: Extended diamond-hole smooth axle
bom.note: Extended smooth axle: 25.354 mm overall, 2.05 mm longer than the approved printed diamond axle. Diamond passage unchanged; existing TPU key reused. Current extended print pending physical assessment.
bom.approval: Design approved; current print pending physical assessment

bom.name: TPU T/V axle snap key
bom.note: Approved (user assessment 2026-10-30). T-head stop and split V tip;14.7 mm overall,3 mm stem/thickness,5 mm relaxed V span. Pinch arms for removal. User confirms key fits the diamond axle; loaded pull-out, wear and creep unmeasured; keeper band retained pending qualification. Cuffs use integral studs.

bom.name: Common long TPU screw
bom.note: Approved (user assessment 2026-10-30). One unchanged 30.2 mm threaded-span 8×3 design: four collar screws and one actuator rail screw. Rail screw projects 12.2 mm farther beyond its nut; head bearing stays unchanged. User selects TPU for tighter feel; loaded retention, creep and thread strength unverified.

bom.name: Common TPU clamp nut
bom.note: Approved (user assessment 2026-10-30). Same 8×3 nut geometry at all five stations. ELEGOO TPU 95A selected by user for tighter feel; hand-tighten only. Sustained preload, creep and thread stripping remain untested.

bom.name: Reversible TPU clip guide
bom.note: Approved (user assessment 2026-10-30). Approved 45-degree square press-stud clip. 12.8 x 17.8 mm opening; original 6 mm band, 1.6 mm walls and straight 35-degree print arm. Only roof and matching stud reshaped. Zero supports in the reviewed TPU slice. Design approved; revised clip unprinted, physical fit and retention untested. Assembly shows open manufactured pose, not a closed deformation simulation.

bom.name: Twine sections joined by inline band
bom.note: Two lengths joined with a rubber band along the neck. Run directly from the pulley to the nearest shaft guide; there are no bracket guide holes; leave enough for knots. Current routing uses the requested 1 mm string; knot clearance and physical routing still need checking.

bom.name: Rubber bands
bom.note: 2 jaw closing + 1 return + 1 inline overtravel + 1 axle-key keeper. Actual preload and loop count need fitting.
